requirements.description: The building must be in energy class D or better, so classes A1 through D are accepted. Geographic preference (Turin, proximity to green spaces) is out of scope and was not translated into a filter.
The user wants the building to be near green spaces. Per the 'near' proximity rule, the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.
